newsitem.title: USA: Invitro funds low, needs merger partner to get by.
newsitem.headline: Invitro funds low, needs merger partner to get by.

text.p: InVitro International said Friday it has enough funds only to sustain the company through September and could cease most of its operations if it did not work out a merger deal by the end of this month.
It said the only operation it might continue, should it fail to get a merger partner, is its effort to market Guardian DNA products.
It said that as an alternative, it would need more revenues or additional capital, which it is not sure it can get, for it to sustain operations after September.

The company, which makes and markets safety-related products, said efforts to find a suitable partner had stalled. Negotiations with one company were terminated and a proposed deal with Miragen Inc was suspended as the suitor needed more financing, it said.

It said it was currently negotiating a proposed merger with another company engaged natural gas development and sales, but a definitive merger proposal has not been executed. It said its management plans to pursue merger negotiations with any suitable prospective candidate.
Guardian DNA relies on genetic material for positively identifying a child and could be used in identifying abducted children.
